title: SharePoint Customization with SPFx & GitHub
description: How to customize SharePoint the modern way: source-controlled SPFx web parts and extensions in a GitHub repo, packaged into .sppkg solutions, deployed through GitHub Actions to the app catalog, and installed on real sites. Includes real copy-pasteable code (manifest, web part, SPHttpClient data fetch, app customizer), the full package lifecycle (add → deploy → install → upgrade), verified deployment actions for CI/CD, and a curated map of the best example galleries and resources to study.
